The HWPX document generation failed because required data values, specifically the date '2026-07-15', were missing from the generated XML sections.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_required_values_present_and_placeholders_removed failed because it could not find the value '2026-07-15' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the setup successfully loaded the XML sections, the assertion 'assert value in combined' failed for the date field, indicating the document automation logic is not correctly injecting all input data into the HWPX schema.
